name: Stripe
description: Trigger workflows from new Stripe customers, succeeded payments and paid or failed invoices, and create customers, issue refunds or read balances and charges from a step.

triggers.label: A customer is created
triggers.description: Fires once for each customer created since the last poll.

env.name: STRIPE_API_KEY
env.description: Leave empty to borrow the Stripe CLI login. A restricted key with read access to customers, charges, invoices and payment intents plus write access to customers and refunds is enough.
env.builderHint: Created under Developers, API keys, Create restricted key; sandbox keys start sk_test_ or rk_test_, live keys sk_live_ or rk_live_. Filled, it is sent as-is and stripe is never run; empty, the connector reads test_mode_api_key from stripe config --list. A publishable pk_ key is refused before any call.

env.name: STRIPE_LIVE_MODE
env.description: true borrows the live key from the CLI profile instead of the test one. A pasted key carries its own mode.
env.builderHint: Reads live_mode_api_key rather than test_mode_api_key from the CLI profile. Objects in one mode are invisible to the other, and every item and output carries livemode.

env.name: STRIPE_PROJECT
env.description: The stripe --project-name profile to borrow from. Blank for the default profile.
env.builderHint: Passed as --project-name to stripe config --list and read as the TOML table of that name; the default table is [default].

env.name: STRIPE_CUSTOMER
env.description: Only this customer’s invoices, for the two invoice triggers. Blank for every customer.
env.builderHint: Sent as the customer filter on GET /v1/invoices; the customer and payment triggers ignore it.

env.name: STRIPE_LOOKBACK_MINUTES
env.description: How far before the watermark the payment and paid-invoice polls re-read, to catch an intent or invoice that succeeded a while after it was created.
env.builderHint: created is when an intent or invoice was made, not when it was paid, so the created filter opens this many minutes before the watermark; bank debits that settle later than this are missed.

env.name: STRIPE_FAILED_LOOKBACK_MINUTES
env.description: How far before now the failed-invoice poll reads open invoices. A day by default, because retries are days apart.
env.builderHint: Stripe records no time for a failed attempt, so this window is measured from now and the dedupe key carries the attempt count.

triggers.label: A payment succeeds
triggers.description: Fires once for each payment intent that reaches succeeded. Amounts are integers in the smallest currency unit.

actions.label: Create a customer
actions.description: Create a customer. Identical inputs within 24 hours return the first customer rather than a second one.

inputs.label: Email
inputs.description: Up to 512 characters, shown in the dashboard.
inputs.builderHint: Not validated for uniqueness by Stripe; two customers may share one.

inputs.label: Name
inputs.description: Full or business name, up to 256 characters.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as name; Stripe stores it as typed.

inputs.label: Description
inputs.description: Free text shown alongside the customer.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as description, often used for an internal account reference.

inputs.label: Metadata
inputs.description: A JSON object of string values, up to 50 keys of 40 characters with values of 500.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as metadata[key]=value form fields; keys may not contain square brackets. Not shown to the customer.

outputs.description: The new customer id, cus_…
Email as saved, or null
Name as saved, or null
Description as saved, or null
When it was created, ISO 8601
The metadata object as stored
False for a sandbox customer
Where to open it in the dashboard

actions.label: Get a customer
actions.description: Read a customer by id. A deleted customer comes back with deleted true and little else.

inputs.label: Customer
inputs.builderHint: Sent URL-encoded as the path segment of GET /v1/customers/:id; an unknown id answers 404 resource_missing.

outputs.description: Customer id, cus_…
Email address, or null
Full or business name, or null
Free text shown alongside the customer
Phone number, or null
Three-letter currency of recurring billing, or null
Current balance in the smallest currency unit; negative is credit
Whether the latest invoice is unpaid past due
When the customer was created, ISO 8601
The metadata object as stored
False for a sandbox customer
Where to open it in the dashboard
True when the customer was deleted

actions.label: List recent charges
actions.description: The most recent charges, newest first. Amounts are integers in the smallest currency unit.

inputs.label: Maximum
inputs.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as limit; 100 is the documented maximum and lists come back newest first.

inputs.label: Customer
inputs.description: Only this customer’s charges. Blank for all.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the customer filter on GET /v1/charges.

inputs.label: Starting after
inputs.description: A charge id from an earlier page, to fetch the next one.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as starting_after, the documented cursor; pass the last id of the previous page while hasMore is true.

outputs.description: One entry per charge: id, amount, amountRefunded, currency, status, paid, refunded, captured, customer, paymentIntent, description, receiptUrl, failureCode, failureMessage, created, livemode
Whether another page follows the last id

actions.label: Refund a payment
actions.description: Refund a payment intent or charge, in full or for an amount in the smallest currency unit. Identical inputs within 24 hours return the first refund.

inputs.label: Payment intent
inputs.description: The pi_… to refund. Give this or a charge.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as payment_intent; Stripe refunds its latest charge.

inputs.label: Charge
inputs.description: The ch_… to refund. Give this or a payment intent.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as charge; the trigger and listCharges outputs carry ids that fit here.

inputs.label: Amount
inputs.description: Integer in the smallest currency unit: 1099 is 10.99 USD, 500 is 500 JPY. Omitted refunds what remains.
inputs.builderHint: Never a decimal; refunding more than remains is an error from Stripe.

inputs.label: Reason
inputs.description: duplicate, fraudulent or requested_by_customer. fraudulent adds the card to the block list.
inputs.builderHint: Optional; shown in the dashboard and reported to the customer’s bank as given.

outputs.description: Refund id, re_…
Refunded amount in the smallest currency unit
Three-letter currency
pending, requires_action, succeeded, failed or canceled
The charge refunded
The payment intent refunded, or null
The reason as saved, or null
Why a refund failed, or null
When it was created, ISO 8601

actions.label: Get the account balance
actions.description: The current balance of the account the key belongs to, in the smallest currency unit per currency.

outputs.description: Funds that can be paid out, as {amount, currency, sourceTypes} per currency
Funds not yet available, in the same shape
Funds held in reserve for Connect, as {amount, currency}
False for a sandbox balance

actions.label: List customers
actions.description: Customers newest first, optionally only those with one exact email address.

inputs.label: Maximum
inputs.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as limit; 100 is the documented maximum and lists come back newest first.

inputs.label: Email
inputs.description: Exact, case-sensitive email address to filter by.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as the email filter, which Stripe documents as a case-sensitive exact match.

inputs.label: Starting after
inputs.description: A customer id from an earlier page, to fetch the next one.
inputs.builderHint: Sent as starting_after, the documented cursor; pass the last id of the previous page while hasMore is true.

outputs.description: One entry per customer: id, email, name, description, phone, currency, balance, delinquent, created, metadata, deleted, livemode, url
Whether another page follows the last id
